title: Split it three ways
setting: After dinner with a third friend, Jordan. The check is on the table and all three are still sitting there. A little faster, same money language.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: Okay, what's the move. Wanna just split it three ways?
lines.spoken: Okay, what's the move. Wanna just split it three ways?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That's easy. I'm good with that.
lines.spoken: That's easy. I'm good with that.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah, except I got the drinks. So maybe you two split the food, and I... I can just keep the drinks?
lines.spoken: Yeah, except I got the drinks. So maybe you two split the food, and I... I can just keep the drinks?

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: Or I can throw in a little extra and we don't do a whole spreadsheet.
lines.spoken: Or I can throw in a little extra and we don't do a whole spreadsheet.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'm not doing a spreadsheet. I'm just saying the drinks were like forty.
lines.spoken: I'm not doing a spreadsheet. I'm just saying the drinks were like forty.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: Forty? Did we drink forty dollars of drinks?
lines.spoken: Forty? Did we drink forty dollars of drinks?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You had two. Maya had one. I had, uh. More than that.
lines.spoken: You had two. Maya had one. I had, uh. More than that.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: So you got the drinks, we split the rest? That's fine.
lines.spoken: So you got the drinks, we split the rest? That's fine.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: I can throw in for the drinks too. I don't want you just eating that.
lines.spoken: I can throw in for the drinks too. I don't want you just eating that.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: It's really fine. I got the drinks. You sure you wanna throw in?
lines.spoken: It's really fine. I got the drinks. You sure you wanna throw in?

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: I can throw in ten bucks and we call it done. I'm not gonna fight you in a restaurant.
lines.spoken: I can throw in ten bucks and we call it done. I'm not gonna fight you in a restaurant.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Okay. Ten's fine. I'll send you... wait, no, you send me ten, I already put my card down.
lines.spoken: Okay. Ten's fine. I'll send you... wait, no, you send me ten, I already put my card down.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: Yep. Doing it now. Maya, you wanna just send him your third of the food?
lines.spoken: Yep. Doing it now. Maya, you wanna just send him your third of the food?

gist.askEn: What are the three of them figuring out?
accept: who pays for drinks vs food

gist.askEn: How do they roughly settle it?
accept: Maya sends her third of the food

details.askZh: 酒水大概多少钱？谁喝得比较多？
details.askEn: About how much were the drinks, and who had more?
accept: Maya had one, Jordan had two

details.askEn: What does Jordan not want to do?
accept: do math in a complicated way

glue.hear: Wanna just split it three ways
glue.noteZh: 句首 Wanna just 没有 you，split it 连读，three ways 才是新信息，前面一团容易被滑掉。
glue.standard: Want to just split it three ways

glue.span: I can throw in a little extra
glue.hear: I can throw in a little extra
glue.noteZh: can 弱读，throw in a little 四个词挤在一起，extra 才比较清楚。
glue.standard: I can throw in a little extra

glue.span: send him your third of the food
glue.hear: send him your third of the food
glue.noteZh: send him 常像 send 'im，your third of the 里 of the 极弱，不要只听到 send 和 food。
glue.standard: send him your third of the food

roleplay.setupZh: 三个人吃完晚饭要对账。你可能已经付了酒水，或者你想简单 AA，不想当场算得很细。把话说清楚，但不要变成会议。
roleplay.aiRole: Play Jordan and Maya as needed. Jordan is practical and a little tired; Maya wants it simple. Someone already put a card down.
variants: Everyone wants to split three ways evenly.
Chris forgot he already put his card down.
Jordan has no cash and has to send the money.
starters: Wanna just split it three ways?
I can throw in ten bucks.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲三个人怎么买单：谁提出 AA，酒水怎么算，最后谁转账给谁。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell how the three of them settled the check: the three-way split, the drinks, and who sent money to whom. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
